xBRIEFInfo.description: Doctor detect + --fix wire always-pin skills into OpenClaw workspaces (#3001).

plan.title: feat(doctor,openclaw): detect missing host skill pins + doctor --fix wire

narratives.Description: OpenClaw can have Directive 0.89+ adapter content but missing always-pin skills under ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills. Extend doctor detect + --fix to deposit/link the four pins (build, pre-pr, review-cycle, swarm) into the main OpenClaw workspace skills root. Cohort add-on alongside ceremony wave (orthogonal).
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Detect OpenClaw via env/OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/~/.openclaw. 2. Check main workspace skills for four always-pins. 3. doctor default: finding + remediation. 4. doctor --fix: symlink or copy from @deftai/directive-content skills; safe non-destructive; multi-seat only with explicit flag. 5. Docs openclaw-agent-host wire step. 6. Tests with temp HOME. 7. CHANGELOG #3001.
narratives.UserStory: As an OpenClaw operator, I want doctor to detect and fix missing Directive pin skills so available_skills loads cold-start paths.
narratives.Overview: Closes #3001. Related #2874 #2968 #2508. Cohort: ceremony-wallclock-2990 active swarm batch (orthogonal leaf).

narrative.Acceptance: Given OpenClaw signals and missing main pins, when deft doctor runs, then a clear finding lists missing skill ids and remediation (doctor --fix).

Given fixMode and OpenClaw detect with missing pins, when deft doctor --fix runs, then the four always-pins are linked or copied into default main workspace skills dir without deleting user skills; re-run doctor is clean for that check.
Docs cover wire step; multi-workspace only via explicit flag; unit tests cover miss/hit/fix with fake HOME; CHANGELOG cites #3001; PR closes #3001.
